title: Exhausted CD8 and CD3E T cells in tumor mass
notes: A MART1-dominant melanocytic tumor region with scattered CD8a+PD1+ T cells at the periphery and within the mass. CD8a and PD1 show strong measured co-localization (IoU 0.66), indicating an exhausted cytotoxic T cell phenotype. The tumor compartment (MART1, ~12.9% coverage) vastly outweighs the immune infiltrate, and CD8a further co-localizes with CD103 (IoU 0.71), suggesting a tissue-resident memory exhausted phenotype embedded in a melanoma-rich microenvironment.
